neighbours.label: personal-hygiene and bathroom items (toiletries, face wash, toothpaste, the bathroom sink or mirror); the same objects in a kitchen or on a car stay quiet
fire: The hostel gives every guest a towel and a small bag of toiletries.
He squeezed toothpaste onto the brush and looked for the floss.
Her morning routine starts with a gentle face wash and cold water.
The plumber fixed the leaking tap on the bathroom sink.
Don't forget your razor, deodorant and shampoo when you pack.
She wiped the steam off the bathroom mirror after her shower.
The gift basket held bath salts, body lotion and a bar of soap.
Travel-size toiletries must fit in a single transparent pouch.
quiet: The hostel gives every guest a map and a small bag of snacks.
He squeezed mustard onto the bread and looked for the ham.
Her morning routine starts with a strong coffee and the radio.
The plumber fixed the leaking pipe under the garden shed.
Don't forget your passport, charger and tickets when you pack.
She wiped the dust off the hallway window after lunch.
The gift basket held crackers, olive oil and a jar of jam.
Travel-size chess sets must fit in a single coat pocket.

notes: Probes: toiletries 0.71, toothpaste 0.69, bathroom sink 0.64, face wash 0.52; kitchen sink 0.05, a car's side mirror 0.01.
